Erratic torque (10-16 kft-lb) with pack-off tendency at 2,988 m MD in Barail coal/shale.
Mitigation: Lowered RPM, added lubricant to mud system and reamed the interval before drilling

Lesson: Monitor the torque trend, not the absolute value, when drilling Barail.

STUCK PIPE at 3,012 m MD (BARAIL) | Severity: HIGH | NPT: 22.0 hrs | MW: 10.8 ppg
String stuck at 3,012 m MD in Barail after 35 min static during survey. Overpull 110 klbs, no
rotation. Freed after 9 hrs of jarring and a 40 bbl pipe-freeing pill.
Mitigation: Applied controlled overpull to 110 klbs, spotted pipe-freeing agent and regained
rotation after 9 hrs; reamed interval twice.
Lesson: Avoid static pipe across Barail coal seams; keep pipe moving during surveys and connections.
